changes: New: hold CUE and press MIDI to see the time left on all eight audio tracks on one screen.
The time left is real time: it follows timestretch, repitch and tempo changes, and flashes in the last 30 seconds.
Close it with NO or CUE + MIDI; a track key pressed twice closes it and opens that track's QUICK ASSIGN, as on stock. LEFT and RIGHT switch the right column between total and time played.
Needs the Modwerk base loaded over USB, which is in the beta. Card firmware cannot include it. While installed, CUE + MIDI no longer switches to the MIDI tracks; MIDI alone still does.
Known issues: a track shows as empty until it has played once since the project loaded; a looping track shows the time to the end of the sample.
